finalMessage:
That's fine — I wasn't asked to commit anything. Porto Notes is implemented and verified. **Summary:** - `index.html` — full page skeleton (form, search box, results line, feed section) with the exact required ids/classes. - `src/style.css` — lightweight, accessible styling (focus outlines, contrast, no external deps). - `src/fixtures.json` — copy of the seed data. - `src/main.ts` — app logic: localStorage persistence with fixture seeding, a tag-allowlist rich-text renderer (``, ``, ``, ``, ``, `
`, newlines) that HTML-escapes everything else and strips unsafe URL schemes (`javascript:` etc.) from both links and avatar `src`, case-insensitive search with a `results-line`, note selection via clickable titles (`aria-current="true"`), and URL-fragment deep links (`#q=…¬e=…`) that restore on reload. Verified via `pnpm build` + `pnpm smoke` (passes) plus an ad-hoc Playwright script covering rich text rendering, search/selection/reload round-trips, and XSS attempts (script tags and `javascript:` URLs are neutralized) — that test script was temporary and has been removed.
